title: PlacementMap
description:
`skills/<id>/map.json` — where a skill is materialized + the hashes that drive no-op uninstall and
exact go-back. **Field-set pinned**; `swap_capability`'s value enum is INFERRED.

**Schema v2** (its OWN ceiling, [`crate::PLACEMENT_MAP_SCHEMA_VERSION`]): a skill may hold SEVERAL
placements (the shared cross-agent dir + per-harness native dirs), each with its own durable state
in [`Self::placement_state`], strictly 1:1 with [`Self::placements`]. A v1 document (one placement,
map-level state only) upgrades losslessly in memory on read; the map-level `materialized_sha` /
`pre_existing_sha` / `swap_capability` fields remain the FIRST placement's mirror, so a v2 document
stays legible to inspection tools that predate the per-placement shape.

harness.description:
The harness this skill was adopted into, when topos recognized one at adopt time (e.g. Claude
Code); `None` for a plain directory tracked in place with no known harness. Drives where the
auto-update trigger applies. **Additive optional** (a `None` placement omits it).

harness_layer.description: The harness layer the placement sits in (e.g. `"user"`), when a harness was recognized.

harness_slug.description:
The registry slug (e.g. `claude-code`, `cursor`) of the agent this placement serves, when ONE
agent owns it: the recognized harness, or the sole installed reader of the folder an added dir
sits in. A folder several agents read has no single owner and a folder none reads has none at
all — both leave this unset. A superset of [`Self::harness`]. **Additive optional.**

materialized_sha.description:
sha256 of the bytes topos actually wrote (the projection sha) — may differ from the source
`bundle_digest` if a harness ever projected; with no projection the two match. The FIRST
placement's mirror in a v2 document (the per-placement truth is `placement_state`).

placement_state.description:
Per-placement durable state, strictly 1:1 with [`Self::placements`] after the read upgrade.
Empty on disk only in a v1 document (the reader synthesizes the single entry from the
map-level fields).

placements.description:
The target dir(s) where the skill is placed (the shared cross-agent dir and/or per-harness
native dirs), 1:1 with [`Self::placement_state`].

pre_existing_sha.description:
sha256 of whatever was in the dir BEFORE placement — restored on uninstall (no-op uninstall).
The FIRST placement's mirror in a v2 document.

swap_capability.description: The FIRST placement's swap capability (the per-placement truth is `placement_state`).

PlacementClaim.description:
What an identity claim recorded about the folder it brought under management.

Its presence is the fact the PLANNERS read: a claimed folder is ALWAYS a target, whatever the
row's shape or the scope's detection says, because "updates land here from now on" is the
claim's whole promise. (An adopted SOURCE folder makes no such promise — it is where the person
works, and a destination-frozen row does not manage it.)

added_dest.description:
The row `dest` entry the claim ADDED, when the row was destination-frozen and did not
already name this folder's root.

The DETACH subtracts exactly this and nothing else. "The row names this folder's root" is
not the same fact as "the claim put it there": a row that already named the root was not
changed by the claim, and taking the entry back would drop copies the claim never touched
— and, where it was the row's only destination, the row with them. **Additive.**

PlacementKind.description:
What a placement dir IS — the shared cross-agent convention dir, or one harness's native skills
dir. **INFERRED value set.**

oneOf.description: The shared cross-agent skills dir (one copy, read by every covered harness).

PlacementState.description:
One placement's durable state (`map.json` v2), 1:1 with [`PlacementMap::placements`]. **Field-set
pinned**; the `kind` value set is INFERRED.

adopted_source.description:
THIS dir is the user's own adopted-in-place SOURCE (`add <path>` recorded it where it
stood; topos never created it). The cleaners treat it as never-deletable: when demand for
the bundle ends, every placement topos wrote retires, but the adopted source dir survives
byte-identical. Sticky for the life of the record. **Additive.**

agent.description:
The registry slug of the harness a `native` placement serves; `None` for `shared`, and for a
dir added in place that no single installed agent owns (the user's own chosen location).

claim.description:
The identity CLAIM that brought this dir under management (`add <path> --as <bundle>`),
when one did. `None` for every dir topos chose itself AND for the folder an in-place adopt
took as the bundle's own source — both are `adopted_source`, and only this tells them
apart. **Additive.**

kind.description: Whether this dir is the shared cross-agent skills dir or one harness's own skills dir.

materialized_sha.description:
sha256 of the bytes topos wrote into THIS dir; `None` = the target is recorded but was never
materialized (a newly added placement awaiting its first apply). Draft detection compares each
dir against ITS recorded sha, so per-dir drift is classified independently.

pre_existing_sha.description: sha256 of whatever was in THIS dir BEFORE topos first wrote into it (sticky).

swap_capability.description: The swap capability probed for THIS dir's filesystem.

SwapCapability.description: Whether the placement dir supports an atomic swap, or must degrade. **INFERRED value set.**

oneOf.description: A degraded rename-dance fallback (no single-syscall swap available).
No safe atomic materialization — refuse or warn.
